name: guided-discovery-ai
description: Platform skeleton for the Guided Discovery AI monorepo.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-unknown --write "*.{cjs,js,json,md,mjs,ts,yaml,yml}" ".devcontainer/**/*" ".github/**/*" "apps/**/*" "backend/**/*" "docker/**/*" "infrastructure/**/*" "packages/**/*" "scripts/**/*" "tests/**/*" "tools/**/*" && python -m ruff format ai tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-unknown --check "*.{cjs,js,json,md,mjs,ts,yaml,yml}" ".devcontainer/**/*" ".github/**/*" "apps/**/*" "backend/**/*" "docker/**/*" "infrastructure/**/*" "packages/**/*" "scripts/**/*" "tests/**/*" "tools/**/*" && python -m ruff format --check ai tests
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:python && pnpm lint:workspaces
scripts.lint:js: eslint eslint.config.mjs jest.config.mjs playwright.config.ts prettier.config.mjs apps backend packages tests tools
scripts.test: pnpm test:javascript && pnpm test:python && pnpm test:workspaces
scripts.validate: pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test:e2e
